verdict.rationale: Parsec's own pricing page lists audit logs (last 7 days) and full audit logs via the Teams API, with API access for automation and reporting, so a log that can be exported programmatically exists. These are one-line bullets only: they never say the logs record connection events (who connected to which machine and when), and probes found no public API docs or OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented audit-log schema showing user/machine/timestamp connection events, a documented export format or console export beyond raw API, published API documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
